description: This file defines the SimService class for a modem simulator, including its interface, internal data structures, and constants related to SIM card management, such as file IDs, PIN management, and facility locks.

classes.name: SimService
classes.description: Main class representing the SIM card service in the modem simulator, managing SIM state, file system, PINs, and facility locks.

classes.name: SimFileSystem
classes.description: Represents the file system structure of the SIM card, including various EF (Elementary File) IDs.

classes.name: PinStatus
classes.description: Tracks PIN and PUK status, remaining attempts, and provides methods for verification and changing PIN/PUK.

classes.name: FacilityLock
classes.description: Represents a facility lock type, its status, and lock mode.

classes.name: LogicalChannel
classes.description: Represents a logical channel for SIM file access, including session ID and open status.

methods.name: GetSimStatus
methods.description: Returns the current SIM card status.

methods.name: GetSimOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator code of the SIM card.

methods.name: HandleSIMStatusReq
methods.description: Handles a request to retrieve the SIM status.

methods.name: HandleChangeOrEnterPIN
methods.description: Handles PIN change or entry commands.

methods.name: HandleSIM_IO
methods.description: Handles SIM IO commands.

methods.name: HandleCSIM_IO
methods.description: Handles CSIM IO commands.

methods.name: HandleGetIMSI
methods.description: Handles request to get IMSI.

methods.name: HandleGetIccId
methods.description: Handles request to get ICCID.

methods.name: HandleFacilityLock
methods.description: Handles facility lock commands.

methods.name: HandleOpenLogicalChannel
methods.description: Handles opening a logical channel.

methods.name: HandleCloseLogicalChannel
methods.description: Handles closing a logical channel.

methods.name: HandleTransmitLogicalChannel
methods.description: Handles transmitting data over a logical channel.

methods.name: HandleChangePassword
methods.description: Handles password change commands.

methods.name: HandleQueryRemainTimes
methods.description: Handles query for remaining PIN/PUK attempts.

methods.name: HandleCdmaSubscriptionSource
methods.description: Handles setting or getting CDMA subscription source.

methods.name: HandleCdmaRoamingPreference
methods.description: Handles setting or getting CDMA roaming preference.

methods.name: HandleSimAuthentication
methods.description: Handles SIM authentication commands.

methods.name: HandlePhoneNumberUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating the phone number stored in the SIM profile.

methods.name: SavePinStateToIccProfile
methods.description: Saves current PIN state to ICC profile.

methods.name: SaveFacilityLockToIccProfile
methods.description: Saves facility lock states to ICC profile.

methods.name: IsFDNEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Fixed Dialing Number (FDN) is enabled.

methods.name: GetPhoneNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the stored phone number.

methods.name: SetPhoneNumber
methods.description: Sets the phone number in the SIM profile.
